title: auth.apply_first_login_policies
description: Raise first-login policies on an EXISTING account (#90). Returns {"applied": [...]} — the policies this call actually raised, a subset of what was asked (one already outstanding is not raised twice; mfa_enroll against an account that already carries a strong factor has nothing left to demand). ADDITIVE, never subtractive: a policy not listed is left exactly as it was, because the callers are per-ORG while the flags are per-ACCOUNT, and a subtractive contract would let one tenant lower another tenant's bar. Canonical caller: the workspaces invitation-accept path applying the org's provisioned_user_policies. Unknown user id is a structured {"error": "error.404.not_found"} rather than a silent no-op — this function makes a change and must say whether it happened.

user_id.description: Primary key of the account to raise the policies on.

policies.description: First-login steps to demand. ADDITIVE — a policy already outstanding stays outstanding, and a policy NOT listed is never lowered.
